defect.finding: VarBench's DMRG row -21.2122722 (its script programs/dmrg_itensors_hubbard/square_16_P_5_2.1544.jl sets U = 2.1544) lies 3.64e-5 below VarBench's exact diagonalization row -21.21223577699911 on the same instance (vendor/varbench/Hubbard/square_16_P_5_2.1544.md; its script scripts/Hubbard/square_16_P_5_2.1544/ed_lattice_symmetries.sh sets --U 2.1544). A variational energy cannot lie below the exact energy of the same Hamiltonian, so the U or the digits of one of the two VarBench files differ from what its script states. The paper prints the exact digits of the ED row (-21.2122357(7), arXiv:2111.10420 Table III, sources/2111.10420.txt) at its label U = 2.15. Both rows stay as VarBench prints them (ruled 2026-11-26: each row stays on the U its own source prints).
